definition_zh: 翱翔；高飞；急升；高耸
definition_en: to fly high in the air, to rise quickly, or to stand very tall
core_image: 一只老鹰在山谷上方展开双翼盘旋
scene: 老鹰在群山上方翱翔。The eagle soared above the mountains.
sceneCN: 这里 soar 是「翱翔」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老鹰在群山上方翱翔。

senses.title: Fly high
senses.definition: to fly or rise high into the air without much effort
senses.definitionCN: 轻松地飞向或升到高空
senses.example: The eagle soared above the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 老鹰在群山上方翱翔。
senses.why: This is the picture at the centre of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词核心的画面。

senses.title: Rise quickly
senses.definition: to increase quickly to a high level
senses.definitionCN: 迅速上升到很高的水平
senses.example: House prices soared last year.
senses.exampleCN: 去年房价飞涨。
senses.why: Rising flight became a metaphor for rising numbers.
senses.whyCN: 向上飞翔被用来比喻数字上涨。

senses.title: Stand tall
senses.definition: to be very tall or to rise high above the surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 非常高，或高高地超出周围
senses.example: The tower soars above the old town.
senses.exampleCN: 这座塔高耸在老城之上。
senses.why: The sense of height extends from flight to buildings.
senses.whyCN: 高度的含义从飞行扩展到建筑。

intro.en: Soar came through Old French from a Latin word for a breeze.
intro.cn: soar 经古法语来自拉丁语中表示微风的词。

items.cn: aura 意为微风或轻柔的空气。

definition_zh: 社会的；社交的；群居的
definition_en: relating to society, to meeting other people, or to living in groups
core_image: 公园里人们三五成群地交谈
scene: 住房是重要的社会问题。Housing is an important social issue.

senses.title: Of society

senses.title: Living in groups

definition_zh: 社会主义；社会主义制度
definition_en: a political and economic system in which the public or the state controls key resources
core_image: 人们共同管理工厂和土地
scene: 社会主义强调公共所有。Socialism stresses public ownership.
sceneCN: 这里 socialism 是「社会主义」（第 1 个义项）；句意：社会主义强调公共所有。

senses.title: Economic system
senses.definition: a system in which the public or the state owns and controls key resources
senses.definitionCN: 由公众或国家拥有并控制关键资源的制度
senses.example: Socialism stresses public ownership.
senses.exampleCN: 社会主义强调公共所有。
senses.why: This is the political and economic sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是政治与经济层面的义项。

senses.title: Body of ideas
senses.definition: the set of ideas that supports such a system
senses.definitionCN: 支持这种制度的一整套思想
senses.example: He studied the history of socialism.
senses.exampleCN: 他研究社会主义的历史。
senses.why: The word also names the movement and its ideas.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也指这一运动及其思想。

definition_zh: 庄严的；隆重的；严肃的；郑重其事的
definition_en: formal and serious in a religious or public setting, not cheerful, or made as a serious promise
core_image: 安静的礼堂里人们肃立不语
scene: 婚礼是庄严的场合。The wedding was a solemn occasion.
sceneCN: 这里 solemn 是「庄严的；隆重的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：婚礼是庄严的场合。

senses.title: Formal and grand
senses.definition: formal and serious in a public or religious ceremony
senses.definitionCN: 在公共或宗教仪式中正式而严肃的
senses.example: The wedding was a solemn occasion.
senses.exampleCN: 婚礼是一个庄严的场合。
senses.why: This is the ceremonial sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是仪式性的义项。

senses.title: Serious in manner
senses.definition: serious and not cheerful in expression or manner

senses.exampleCN: 他板着严肃的面孔听。
senses.why: The word describes a person's manner.
senses.whyCN: 这个词描述一个人的举止。

senses.title: Made as a vow
senses.definition: made as a serious and binding promise

senses.example: She made a solemn promise to return.
senses.exampleCN: 她郑重承诺会回来。
senses.why: A promise borrows the weight of ceremony.
senses.whyCN: 承诺借用了仪式的分量。

intro.en: Solemn comes from Latin sollemnis, meaning fixed or ceremonial.
intro.cn: solemn 来自拉丁语 sollemnis，意为固定的或仪式的。

items.en: Sollemnis meant yearly, fixed, or ceremonial.
items.cn: sollemnis 意为每年的、固定的或仪式的。

items.en: Solemne kept the sense of religious formality.
items.cn: solemne 保留了宗教仪式的正式含义。

items.en: The word entered English as solemn.
items.cn: 这个词以 solemn 进入英语。

items.en: It widened to any serious public event.
items.cn: 词义扩展到任何严肃的公共活动。

items.en: It also described a serious promise or manner.
items.cn: 它也形容严肃的承诺或举止。

note.en: Solemn is compared with look-alike words and words for serious manner.

entries.definition: a tall stone post or a vertical section

normalIntro.en: Solemn marks an occasion heavy with meaning and quiet.
normalIntro.cn: solemn 标记一个意义沉重、安静无声的场合。

normal.en: The wedding was a solemn occasion.
normal.cn: 婚礼是一个庄严的场合。

normal.en: He listened with a solemn face.

normal.en: She made a solemn promise to return.

normal.en: Solemn music began as they entered.
normal.cn: 他们入场时响起了庄严的音乐。

abstract.en: Some moments ask us to be still and mean it.

abstract.en: A promise is heavier when it is spoken slowly.
abstract.cn: 慢慢说出的承诺更沉重。

abstract.en: Ceremony gives shape to feelings too large for words.

examples.en: The wedding was a solemn occasion.

examples.en: She made a solemn promise to return.

root: 拉丁语 sollemnis（每年举行的、固定的、仪式的），经古法语 solemne 进入英语，核心义「庄重有仪式感的」。

sensesIntro.en: Solemn means formal and grand, serious in manner, or made as a binding promise.

core.en: A moment made heavy by meaning.

branches.en: Guests stand for a wedding.
branches.cn: 宾客在婚礼上肃立。

branches.en: A face holds back a smile.
branches.cn: 一张脸忍住不笑。

branches.en: Words are spoken as a vow.
branches.cn: 话语作为誓言说出。

branches.en: Ceremony and promise borrow each other's weight.
branches.cn: 仪式与承诺互相借来分量。

branches.en: A serious face makes a promise believable.
branches.cn: 严肃的面孔让承诺可信。

intro.en: Solemn builds words for ceremony, seriousness, and vows.
intro.cn: solemn 构成表示仪式、严肃和誓言的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source sollemnis meant ceremonial or yearly.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源 sollemnis 意为仪式的或每年的。

items.example: Solemn music filled the church.

latinEntries.example: Sollemnis is the Latin source of solemn.

definition_zh: 事务律师；推销员；募捐者
definition_en: a lawyer who advises clients in Britain, a person who seeks business or donations, or a person who asks for something

core.en: A person who is asked to act for others.

intro.en: Solution comes from Latin solutio, a loosening.
intro.cn: solution 来自拉丁语 solutio，意为松开。

items.en: Solvere meant to loosen, untie, or pay.
items.cn: solvere 意为松开、解开或支付。

items.en: Solutio meant a loosening or an explanation.
items.cn: solutio 意为松开或解释。

items.en: Solution kept the sense of untangling.
items.cn: solution 保留了理清纠缠的意思。

items.en: The word entered English as solution.
items.cn: 这个词以 solution 进入英语。

items.en: Science gave it the sense of a dissolved mixture.
items.cn: 科学赋予它溶解混合物的意思。

note.en: Solution is compared with look-alike words and words for answers and mixtures.
note.cn: 把 solution 与形近词以及表示答案和混合物的词作比较。

entries.definition: a reply or a correct response
a way to cure or fix a problem

normalIntro.en: A solution is a knot that has been loosened.
normalIntro.cn: solution 是一个被解开的结。

normal.en: The team found a simple solution.
normal.cn: 团队找到了一个简单的解决办法。

normal.en: The nurse cleaned the cut with a salt solution.
normal.cn: 护士用盐溶液清洗伤口。

normal.en: She checked her solution against the answer key.
normal.cn: 她对照答案检查了自己的解答。

normal.en: There is no easy solution to the housing problem.
normal.cn: 住房问题没有简单的解决办法。

normal.en: The solution turned the water blue.
normal.cn: 这种溶液把水变成了蓝色。

abstract.en: Every problem looks simpler once it is untied.
abstract.cn: 每个问题一旦被解开，看起来都简单些。

abstract.en: Some answers dissolve rather than break.
abstract.cn: 有些答案是被溶解的，而不是被击碎的。

abstract.en: The word for solving and the word for dissolving are one.
abstract.cn: 解决与溶解在同一个词里。

dict_mnemonic.text: solution 与 solve、soluble 同根；find a solution 是「找到解决办法」，salt solution 是「盐溶液」。

root: 拉丁语 solutio（松开、解开），源于 solvere（松开、解开），核心义「把缠结解开」。

sensesIntro.en: Solution is a way to solve a problem, a dissolved liquid mixture, or an answer to a puzzle.
sensesIntro.cn: solution 指解决问题的办法、溶解形成的液体混合物，或谜题的解答。

core.en: A knot loosened until it opens.
core.cn: 被松开到解开的结。

branches.en: A team unties a practical problem.
branches.cn: 团队解开一个实际问题。

branches.en: Salt loosens into water.
branches.cn: 盐在水中化开。

branches.en: A puzzle gives way to an answer.
branches.cn: 谜题让位于答案。

branches.en: Practical and mental problems are both untied.
branches.cn: 实际问题和头脑问题都会被解开。

branches.en: Solving and dissolving share one image of loosening.
branches.cn: 解决与溶解共用「松开」的意象。

intro.en: Solution builds words for solving, dissolving, and answers.
intro.cn: solution 构成表示解决、溶解和答案的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb solvere meant to loosen or untie.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语动词 solvere 意为松开或解开。

items.meaning: a way to solve or a dissolved mixture
items.example: The solution was cheaper than expected.
items.exampleCN: 这个解决办法比预想的便宜。

items.example: They compared three solutions.
items.exampleCN: 他们比较了三个解决办法。

items.meaning: to find an answer to a problem
items.example: Can you solve the puzzle?
Sugar is soluble in water.

items.meaning: the substance dissolved in a liquid
items.example: The solute settles at the bottom.

items.meaning: to discover a way to fix a problem
items.example: They worked all night to find a solution.
items.exampleCN: 他们通宵工作以找到解决办法。

items.meaning: water with salt dissolved in it

They took a solution-focused approach.
items.exampleCN: 他们采取聚焦解决方案的做法。
